skill.name: baoyu-infographic
skill.description: Generates professional infographics with 20 layout types and 17 visual styles. Analyzes content, recommends layout×style combinations, and generates publication-ready infographics. Use when user asks to create "infographic", "信息图", "visual summary", or "可视化".
skill.summary: Creates professional infographic plans, prompts, and image outputs from source content.
skill.author: jimliu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, inline backticks, or visual design terms such as grid and system. Two hidden-file findings are confirmed because the workflow reads a fixed EXTEND.md preference path in the user home directory; no prompt injection or exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Hidden user preference file access is performed without explicit per-run confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Ask before reading $HOME/.baoyu-skills/baoyu-infographic/EXTEND.md and display only schema-defined preference fields.

remediation.issue: Project and user EXTEND.md content can influence layout, style, and language choices.
remediation.suggestion: Treat EXTEND.md as untrusted input, ignore executable instructions, and allow only schema-defined preference fields.

remediation.issue: Markdown shell examples trigger static command warnings.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that the Bash snippet only performs fixed existence checks, or replace it with tool-neutral file existence instructions.

content.value_statement: Turning notes or reports into a clear visual can take many design decisions. This skill analyzes content, recommends layouts and styles, and prepares an image prompt for Claude, Codex, or Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes source content for topic, structure, audience, language, tone, and design instructions.
Recommends three to five layout and visual style combinations with rationale.
Supports 20 layout patterns and 17 visual styles through reference files.
Creates structured Markdown content that preserves source facts and quotes verbatim.
Builds a consolidated image prompt and routes it to an available image generation skill.
Organizes outputs in an infographic folder with analysis, structured content, prompts, and image files.
limitations: Requires an available image generation skill to produce the final image.
Does not verify factual accuracy beyond the source material provided by the user.
Large or dense source documents may need user pruning for readable infographic text.
Generated visuals can require manual review for brand, accessibility, and text rendering quality.

use_cases.title: Turn Lessons Into Visual Summaries
use_cases.description: Create classroom infographics from lesson notes while preserving key definitions and examples.

use_cases.title: Compare Features And Offers
use_cases.description: Map product comparisons into matrix, bento, or funnel layouts for campaigns and sales materials.

use_cases.title: Present Metrics Visually
use_cases.description: Convert KPIs, status notes, and report highlights into dashboard-style infographic prompts.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Default Infographic
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for pasted source text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an infographic from this text. Use the default layout and style. Keep all facts exactly as written: [paste content]

prompt_templates.title: Use A Source File
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic file-based workflow with format preferences.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill on docs/report.md with a portrait aspect ratio and English labels. Recommend the best layout and style before generating.

prompt_templates.title: Guide A Comparison Design
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt with a preferred structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a comparison infographic from this product matrix. Use comparison-matrix plus corporate-memphis unless your analysis finds a better match: [paste table]

prompt_templates.title: Prepare A Multilingual Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with language confirmation and full artifacts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multilingual infographic package from this research summary. Detect source language, ask before translating labels, and produce analysis, structured content, and final image prompt.

output_examples.input: A project brief about onboarding steps and milestones.
output_examples.output: A landscape process infographic package with analysis notes, structured content, a linear-progression prompt, and a generated image path.

output_examples.input: A comparison of three tools with features, pricing, and tradeoffs.
output_examples.output: A comparison matrix recommendation with corporate Memphis styling, option rationale, and a prompt ready for image generation.

output_examples.input: Chinese training notes for a policy rollout.
output_examples.output: A portrait infographic plan in Chinese labels with preserved source data and selected layout and style options.

best_practices: Provide clear source content and state the target audience before generation.
Review the recommended layout and style before approving final image generation.
Keep infographic text concise so the visual output remains readable.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent statistics or fill missing facts.
Do not skip review when source material contains sensitive or regulated information.
Do not overload one infographic with long paragraphs or too many sections.

faq.question: Does this skill generate the final image?
faq.answer: It prepares the image prompt and calls an available image generation skill when one is installed.

faq.question: Can I choose the layout and style?
faq.answer: Yes. You can provide layout and style options, or let the skill recommend combinations.

faq.question: What input formats work best?
faq.answer: Markdown, notes, reports, tables, and pasted text work best when the key facts are clear.

faq.question: Can it work in languages other than English?
faq.answer: Yes. It detects source and user language and asks before changing visible text language.

faq.question: Will it summarize my content?
faq.answer: It structures content for visual use, but its instructions preserve source facts and wording.

faq.question: Where are outputs saved?
faq.answer: The workflow stores analysis, structured content, prompts, source material, and the image under an infographic topic folder.
